extraction.document_summary: AIA Platinum AccidentCare is a personal accident plan designed to provide 24-hour protection for accidental deaths and injuries, with additional assistance and reimbursements. Core payouts are tied to a “coverage amount” and can reach up to 150% of that coverage amount for events listed in the “Schedule of Indemnity,” including “Permanent total disablement” (150% of coverage amount) and certain burn/disability outcomes. The plan also includes an “Aviation Accident Benefit” that pays an additional amount equal to the coverage amount when death occurs due to an injury sustained on a flight (double indemnity). In addition to lump sum benefits, it reimburses overseas emergency medical evacuation and repatriation (unlimited) and covers categories of medical expenses and supportive care (e.g., TCM/chiropractor, mobility aids/home modification after major disability, and rehabilitation therapy). Plans are offered as Silver (S$1,000,000 coverage), Gold (S$3,000,000), and Diamond (S$5,000,000) for the core accidental death/dismemberment/burns benefit; accidental medical reimbursement and mobility/home-modification limits scale by plan.
quality_notes: Brochure contains clear plan tables for Silver/Gold/Diamond and several named benefits with explicit limits and (where available) percentages.

Entry/maximum age, exact underwriting method, and many eligibility conditions are not stated in the provided text (only limited conditional notes are provided, e.g., age 75 reduction and a 50% claims condition for mobility aids/home modification).
Optional benefits include a weekly-income structure and a monthly support benefit; the monthly amount is shown for some plan columns but Diamond monthly amount is not clearly visible in the excerpt.

policies.quick_summary: Personal accident plan with core lump-sum payouts for accidental death, dismemberment and burns (up to 150% of coverage amount) plus aviation double indemnity, overseas emergency medical evacuation/repatriation (unlimited), and multiple reimbursement/support benefits (e.g., medical reimbursement, TCM/chiropractor, mobility aids/home modification, rehabilitation support, compassionate visit). Plans offered: Silver (S$1,000,000), Gold (S$3,000,000), Diamond (S$5,000,000) coverage amount for core benefits; accidental medical reimbursement and other sub-limits increase by plan. Certain benefits reduce by 50% at age 75.
coverage_scope: Accidental death, accidental dismemberment and burns (core benefit)
Aviation accident deaths while travelling as a fare-paying passenger on a flight (double indemnity via Aviation Accident Benefit)
Overseas emergency medical evacuation arrangement and repatriation of mortal remains (reimbursements and repatriation payout)
Medical expense reimbursements for specified treatments and nursing/ambulance services
TCM and chiropractor medical reimbursement (as a complementary benefit)
Mobility aids and home modification expenses after a major disability (subject to eligibility condition)
Rehabilitation support treatment expenses for therapists after a major disability (including TCM/chiropractor note is included under coverage description)
Compassionate visit travel/accommodation expenses for a relative/friend while insured is hospitalised overseas
Illness-related accidents coverage mentioned (e.g., dengue fever and food poisoning) and certain recreational sports mishaps (as described in brochure text)
policies.eligibility_notes: Mobility aids/home modification benefit eligibility: “total claims paid or payable due to 1 accident under Accidental Death, Accidental Dismemberment and Burns Benefit (other than for Loss of Life) must be at least 50% of the coverage amount.” Rehabilitation support is “upon a major disability.” Overseas references include “outside Singapore, your home country and your usual place of residence or employment.”
important_caveats: The brochure states: “There are exclusions applicable to the policy and specific benefits whereby no benefits will be payable.” Specific exclusions are not listed in the provided excerpt.

Age reduction: “The coverage amount for Accidental Death, Accidental Dismemberment and Burns Benefit, Aviation Accident Benefit and Accidental Medical Reimbursement Benefit will be reduced by 50% when you turn age 75.”
Mobility/home modification eligibility condition: “total claims paid or payable due to 1 accident… must be at least 50% of the coverage amount.”
Payout timing note for permanent disability: “The payout for permanent disability will begin 6 months after the disability was first suffered.”
